summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle on every install
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fetches the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunBinary, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { cwd: D })`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) heavily obfuscated in the obfuscator.io style: `_0xNNNN` identifiers, a large mixed integer/string constant pool (`n7gIxM`), a string-array rotation routine (`WV8StW`), and a custom-alphabet base64-like decoder (`hc1jfK9`). Execution is unconditional at `npm install` time, on every installer. The Bun runtime is unrelated to the advertised charting purpose of the package, and the payload delivered under it is opaque to Node-based inspection — this is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern in which install-time code is executed under a freshly downloaded alien runtime so that Node-only tooling cannot observe its behavior. The `@servicetitan` scope is a well-known vendor namespace, and this artifact's install-time shape does not match a legitimate charting library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
